summary.tldr: Creates a tuition payment program for some students with disabilities and excludes those payments from taxable income.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister to pay tuition fees directly to a designated educational institution for an enrolled person who qualifies for the disability tax credit, subject to set conditions.
Deems tuition paid under this program to be a grant to the student.
Adds those tuition payments to the list of amounts that are not included in income under the Income Tax Act.
Allows regulations to set the conditions that must be met before a payment can be made.
who_it_affects: People who qualify for the disability tax credit
summary.background: The bill amends the Income Tax Act and the Canada Student Financial Assistance Act to provide financial assistance for Canadians with disabilities who want to attend post-secondary education.
